title: Compiling Known Rules into Compact Neural Agents: Weight-Space Programming on Unseen Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.16981v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight-space programming (WSP) uses language models to construct neural network weights without training. We test whether known game mechanics can be compiled into compact agents that generalise to held-out levels, renderings and start states within a game family. Writers receive simulator source with held-out level data removed for 20 privately authored, unpublished ARC-AGI-3-style game families. With a fixed 57k-parameter recurrent architecture, the strongest writer reaches 56% held-out-level success with feedback, while the four main writers' Python players reach 97-100%. An exploratory free-architecture condition reaches 68-90%. Learning from support-level examples transfers much less well, but these learners lack the source information given to writers. Written networks have a program-like structure: 93% of parameters are zero, and 90% of the rest are small integers or powers of two. NumPy players under comparable computation caps r

translated_title: 将已知规则编译为紧凑神经智能体：在未见过的游戏上进行权重空间编程
translated_abstract: 权重空间编程使用语言模型在不进行训练的情况下直接构建神经网络权重。我们测试了能否将已知的游戏机制编译成紧凑的智能体，使其能够泛化到同一游戏族中留出的关卡、渲染画面和起始状态。针对20个私人编写、未公开发表的ARC-AGI-3风格游戏族，编写者获得的是已移除留出关卡数据的模拟器源代码。在固定的5.7万参数循环架构下，最强的编写者在有反馈的情况下达到56%的留出关卡成功率，而四位主要编写者的Python玩家则达到97%–100%；探索性的自由架构条件达到68%–90%。从支持集关卡示例中学习的迁移效果差得多，但这些学习者缺乏编写者所获得的源代码信息。编写出的网络呈现出类程序的结构：93%的参数为零，其余参数中90%是小整数或2的幂。在可比计算上限下的NumPy玩家……（原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出“权重空间编程”方法：语言模型通过阅读模拟器源代码，无需任何训练即可直接写出神经网络权重，将已知游戏规则“编译”成仅5.7万参数的紧凑智能体，该智能体能泛化到从未见过的游戏关卡（固定架构成功率56%，自由架构达68%–90%），且所得权重呈现93%为零、以小整数和2的幂为主的类程序稀疏结构。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces weight-space programming, where language models read simulator source code and directly write neural network weights without any training, "compiling" known game rules into compact 57k-parameter agents that generalize to unseen game levels (56% success with a fixed architecture, 68–90% with a free architecture), while the resulting weights exhibit a program-like sparse structure with 93% zeros.
